card.name: Words before a drug class noun
card.fires_on: Words like another, other, different, one or a that come right before a drug class name such as JAK inhibitor, TNF blocker or DPP-4 inhibitor. Also non-biologic before DMARDs.

modes.label: Another or different drug of a class
modes.description: A word such as another, other or different that points to a second drug in the same class.
modes.example: treated with<< another>> JAK inhibitor, a higher rate of

modes.label: Non-biologic before DMARDs
modes.description: The end of non-biologic, or an opening parenthesis, ahead of the term DMARDs.
modes.example: or in combination with non-bi<<ologic>> disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs

modes.label: Switching between drugs
modes.description: A word such as one or a that refers to a single drug of a class when switching or after failure.
modes.example: Care should be taken when switching from<< one>> biologic to another

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word agent or agents next.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to name another drug of the same type, such as a different inhibitor or blocker.
